test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the alternative from the given options that best expresses the same sentence in active/passive voice.

Who built this colossal architectural structure?

options.text: Who had this colossal architectural structure built?
By whom was this colossal architectural structure built?
By whom has this colossal architectural structure been built?
By whom is this colossal architectural structure built?

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Who built this colossal architectural structure?"
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "this colossal architectural structure" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "built" to "was built" (simple past passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "whom."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"By whom was this colossal architectural structure built?"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"Who had this colossal architectural structure built?" – This is in a different tense and changes the meaning.
 
• **Option 3: **"By whom has this colossal architectural structure been built?" – Incorrect tense (present perfect passive).
 
• **Option 4: **"By whom is this colossal architectural structure built?" – Incorrect tense (present simple passive).
